name: Inventory every AI system on your n8n instance and trace who it reaches

parameters.content:
## Inventory every AI system on your n8n instance and trace who it reaches

### Who's it for

Anyone who runs a shared n8n instance and can no longer answer, from memory, which workflows call a model and where that output ends up. Ops leads, platform owners, and anyone who has to produce an AI inventory for a client, an auditor or a board.

### How it works

It reads every workflow on the instance through the n8n API, finds the nodes that call a model, and then walks forward from each one through the connections to every node that reaches people — a social publisher, an email sender, a messenger. For each path it records what stood in between: a disclosure or labelling step, a human approval gate, or nothing at all. Each AI system comes out as one row with its workflow, its model, where it reaches, and the evidence path written out node by node.

### How to set up

1. Add an n8n API credential (Settings, then n8n API, create a key) to the Read all workflows node.
2. Run it manually once and read the summary.
3. Leave the schedule on if you want a weekly inventory.

### Conventions it understands

The analysis reads your node names. Tag a publishing node [exit], a labelling or disclosure step [ai disclosure], and a node that tells people they are dealing with AI [ai disclosed] or [persons informed]. A sub-workflow call counts as a human gate when its name contains gate, approval or review, or when you tag it [human gate]. Anything not tagged is guessed from the node type, and unclear destinations come back as verify rather than a false pass.

### Statuses, worst first

uncovered - reaches people with no disclosure and no gate · likeness - face or voice generator reaching people undisclosed · inform - emotion or biometric system running on people who are not told · chatbot - talks to people without saying it is an AI · verify - destination unclear, tag it · editorial - human gate but no disclosure · disclosed - every path passes a disclosure step · informed - people are told · internal - never reaches people

### Source

Extracted from an open-source EU AI Act transparency kit, where this inventory is the registry half: https://github.com/karusrus/transparency-kit

## 1 · Start it
Run it by hand the first time, then leave the schedule on for a weekly inventory. Nothing is written anywhere, so it is safe to run whenever.

## 2 · Read every workflow
Needs an n8n API credential. Returns the full JSON of every workflow, including nodes and connections.

## 3 · Find the AI and follow it
Finds nodes that call a model, then walks every path forward to the nodes that reach people and records what stood in between.

## 4 · Two outputs
A one-line summary you can send anywhere, and the full inventory as a CSV you can hand to a client or an auditor. Replace either with your own destination.
